control.distance_target: TV and unhalved Hellinger squared of the declared analytic Gaussian-control law, conditional on exact likelihood arithmetic
control.interval_target: expectation of bounded fixed evaluated bridge functions under genuine source P0/P1 draws; no machine-roundoff certificate

actual.distance_target: bounded bridge proxy using saved refined actual-prior likelihoods; true TV/Hellinger not certified
actual.interval_target: equal-weight expectation of proxy bridge functions under genuine source P0/P1 draws only

calibration_usage: none; only original evaluation LLR arrays enter statistics
interval_method: stratified weighted Hoeffding with each source law weighted 1/2; simultaneous Bonferroni over 112 rows times 2 metrics
reuse: shared null populations across alternatives and R-prefix reuse; no joint independence assumption
proxy_error: no certified global log-ratio error bound; observed refinement error is never promoted to one
projection: monotone single-frame Hellinger plug-in and band propagation; exact iid-law theorem only under exact true-distance premise; actual proxy extrapolation has no distance or calibration guarantee
science_scope: saved-data bounded distances, not rerunning detection or adding receiver/decoder/confirmation observations
